Company Description

TempChain provides advanced passive cold chain transport solutions designed to protect temperature-sensitive products across global logistics networks. The company serves customers in industries such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and advanced materials, combining engineering excellence, innovative technology, and operational expertise to deliver reliable and efficient temperature-controlled transportation solutions.
As TempChain expands its global operations, we are investing in the development of an integrated digital ecosystem to support our international leasing operations, container fleet management, supply chain visibility, and data-driven decision-making.
We are looking for talented professionals who want to contribute to building the next generation of digital infrastructure for the global pharmaceutical cold chain industry.
Role Description
The
Senior Solutions Architect / Technical Product Manager
will lead the design, development, and implementation of TempChain's digital platforms, supporting the company's global operations and long-term technology strategy.
This full-time, hybrid role is based in the Seoul-Incheon Metropolitan Area, combining on-site collaboration with work-from-home flexibility.
The successful candidate will take ownership of the technical architecture and development roadmap for an integrated digital ecosystem, including a customer leasing portal, global inventory and asset management system, operational management platform, and centralized data analytics infrastructure.
Working closely with management, manufacturing, commercial, and operations teams, as well as external software development partners, the role will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and oversee their successful implementation.
Key responsibilities include designing system architectures, managing software development projects, integrating ERP and warehouse management systems (WMS), establishing data infrastructure, and developing capabilities for temperature monitoring, operational analytics, risk assessment, cost optimization, and CO₂ emissions analysis.
The position offers significant ownership and the opportunity to shape TempChain's technology strategy from the ground up, with potential progression into a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role as the company grows.
Key Responsibilities
Digital Architecture & Platform Development:
Design and oversee the architecture and development of integrated SaaS platforms supporting global leasing and logistics operations.
Global Inventory & Asset Management:
Develop systems for real-time visibility of container availability, location, condition, utilization, and lifecycle management across international warehouse networks.
Customer Portal & Leasing Platform:
Lead the development of customer-facing platforms for quotations, reservations, leasing, container tracking, and customer account management.
System Integration:
Design and manage integrations between ERP, WMS, logistics systems, IoT devices, and external partner platforms through APIs and data interfaces.
Data Analytics & Intelligence:
Establish centralized data infrastructure for analyzing temperature performance, shipment risk, operational efficiency, logistics costs, fleet utilization, and CO₂ emissions.
Technical Product Management:
Translate business requirements into technical specifications, product roadmaps, development priorities, and implementation plans.
External Development Management:
Coordinate and supervise external software development companies, ensuring technical quality, delivery timelines, system reliability, and alignment with business objectives.
Technology Strategy:
Establish long-term technology direction, development standards, and scalable infrastructure while gradually building internal engineering capabilities.
Qualifications
Strong Solution Architecture skills, with the ability to design scalable, secure, and integrated software platforms.
Experience in software development, system integration, and enterprise architecture, including APIs, databases, and data flows.
Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, inventory management, asset management, or other enterprise operational systems.
Technical Product Management experience, including requirements gathering, product roadmaps, and software development lifecycle management.
Experience managing external software development teams, technical vendors, or complex implementation projects.
Ability to analyze and optimize business processes related to logistics, inventory, leasing, and operational management.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience developing B2B SaaS platforms or enterprise technology solutions.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, databases, system security, and software architecture.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English; Korean language proficiency is an advantage.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in logistics, supply chain, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or cold chain industries.
Experience integrating IoT devices, temperature sensors, GPS tracking, and other operational data sources.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with data analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML applications.
Experience building or scaling technology platforms within startups or international organizations.
What we offer
The opportunity to lead the development of a global digital platform from its early stages.
Direct involvement in strategic technology decisions and digital transformation initiatives.
Significant ownership and autonomy in shaping the company's technology architecture and roadmap.
Collaboration with international customers, logistics partners, and technology providers.
Opportunity to establish and lead an internal technology and engineering team.
Potential career progression into a CTO position as the company expands.
